title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 03 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CHSL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CHSL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Odometer : Distance :: Ammeter : ?
questions.explanation: Odometer measures distance; ammeter measures electric current.

questions.question: Find the missing term: 2, 12, 36, 80, 150, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If CREDIT is coded as ETGFKV, how is DEBIT coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +2: D to F, E to G, B to D, I to K, T to V so FGDKV.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: P is the brother of Q. R is the father of P. S is the mother of T. T is the sister of Q. How is S related to R?
questions.explanation: R is father of P and Q; T is sister of Q so T is also child of R. S is mother of T, hence S is wife of R.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 m North, turns right and walks 6 m, turns right and walks 10 m, then turns left and walks 4 m. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: After two right turns of 10 m he is 6 m East of start, then left 4 m further East: 10 m East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are papers. Conclusions: I. Some pens are papers. II. Some books are pens.
questions.explanation: All pens are books implies some books are pens (II). I does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 121, 143, 169, 187, 209
questions.explanation: 121, 143, 187 and 209 are multiples of 11; 169 = 13 x 13 is not.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. A is second to the left of C. B is to the immediate right of C. D is at one end. E is between A and D. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order D-E-A-C-B. Middle is A.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2023 was Tuesday, what day was 15 August 2024?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year and 15 Aug is after 29 Feb, so +2 days: Tuesday to Thursday.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the next: AZ, CX, FU, JQ, ?
questions.explanation: First letters +2,+3,+4,+5 = O; second -2,-3,-4,-5 = L. So OL.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a clock shows 3:40, the mirror image time is?
questions.explanation: Mirror time = 11:60 minus 3:40 = 8:20.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once and a hole is punched at the centre of the folded edge. After unfolding how many holes?
options: Two holes along the fold line
questions.explanation: A single fold duplicates the punch across the crease.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: The proverb means some glittering things are not gold.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 11th from the left and B is 31st from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B from left = 40-31+1 = 10th. A is 11th. Adjacent, so 0 between them.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If P > Q >= R = S < T, which is definitely true?
questions.explanation: P > Q >= R = S implies P > S.

questions.subject: Reasoning
